en: "You mustn't say that, mogu."{w}{p}"I heard that if the Kin of Darkness get driven out, the current god of time, Naru or whatever the name is, might carve in the start stamp for you, mogu."{w}
note: Answers Urna's "who cares about that thing" (3892, the monument). 'tte itteta' (someone said) read as hearsay, matching "I definitely heard that" at 4080. Kaishi no kokuin = "start stamp" as in slice_031.

en: "Hmph."{w}
"Th-then you'd be a proper New Land, Princess, mogu?"{w}
"..........{w}...Huh, you lot?{w}What are you doing standing around there?"{w}{p}"Come on, get going already!"{w}
"Good luck taking down the Demon Dukes, moguuu!"{w}
note: Plural: the next row says all of them were beaten.

en: "You beat every last Demon Duke!{w}Good for youuu~{w}All right then, I forgive you for everything!!"{w}
You got a pat on the head.{w}
note: Passive in source (atama wo naderareta); Urna pats the party.

en: "Now this place is nice and comfy!"{w}
note: Kaiteki ni natta: the land is pleasant now the invaders are gone.

en: "And now the Princess will graciously accept the wine too, mogu."{w}
note: Raizam echoes Urna's condescending "uketotte ageru" from 3877; "graciously" carries the ageru.

en: "Yeah. So, let me say it properly.{w}Thank you! I've received it, for real!"{w}
You gave Urna the Yuan Wine!{w}
"And also... I'm sorry for calling you a bunch of trash."{w}
note: Refers to Urna's "gomi-domo" line in the villains' scene (slice_014 rendered it "pieces of trash"); the party never heard it, hence 3915.

en: Urna apologized sheepishly, but you had no idea what she meant.{w}
"...N-never mind. Forget it. Hahaha..."{w}
"Oh, that's right, Princess. While you're at it, you should ask them for that thing, mogu."{w}
note: Plain \n dropped (auto-wrap).

en: "'That thing'... Wha--!?"{w}
"Listen, the Princess has a favor to ask you, mogu. Please hear her out, mogu."{w}

"You idiot, don't go saying stuff like that on your own!!{w}Ahh... um, it's nothing big, really.{w}It's just... if... only if you want to, but..."{w}{p}"If living in Fiona's land ever gets too hard for you, you can come to my land, you know..."{w}{p}"I-I mean, come on! Fiona's land, right!?{w}Doesn't it look super boring!?{w}She's gloomy and stuck-up and selfish!!"{w}
note: aitsu = Fiona (the land just named).

en: "That's you, Princess, mogu..."{w}
note: Raizam: those traits describe Urna herself.

en: "So, um... how do I put it..."{w}
"See, the Princess only has the four of us, so she's lonely, mogu."{w}
note: boku-ra 4-nin = the Four Sages.

en: "H-hey, you!!"{w}
"A-anyway, that's how it is.{w}If you don't want to come, you don't have to, okay!?"{w}
"...There you go saying that again, mogu."{w}
"But if you do want to come, you're welcome anytime...{w}There's nothing there yet, but we'll all build it up together from here on."{w}{p}"One more time, just like the old days... okay?"{w}
"May your journey be a safe one.{w}...Here, take this with you."{w}
"See you around, my darling children!"{w}
"Heh heh heh. My land... huh.{w}
note: Quote left open on purpose: first fragment of a build-up (3949/3951/3953); the {0E} part of the next row redraws this text, and 3953 closes the quote.

en:
{0E}"Heh heh heh. My land... huh.{0F}
Heh... heheh...{w}
note: Build-up fragment; {0E} part matches 3949 exactly. Quote closes in 3953. \n kept as in source (one fragment per line).
nimaa = a sound-word grin; the tilde stands for the note mark.

en: "Princess, cut it out, it's creepy, mogu..."{w}
"But come onnn~{w}How could I NOT be happy about this!?{w}Kufufufufu~"{w}
Urna and the others look so happy.{w}
note: Urna-tachi: Urna and her companions (Raizam at least); kept as "the others".

en: "Huh...!?{w}Eurati... a...???{w}...No way. Can't be. Yeah."{w}
Urna looked at {0A:0003:000F}, tilting her head in puzzlement.{w}
note: {0A:0003:000F} = a party member's name; no pronoun used for them.

en: "Haha, sorry, sorry. I just thought you kind of looked like someone I knew.{w}...Not that there's any way they'd still be alive, though."{w}
note: shiriai (Euratia, gender unknown) -> "someone" / "they".

en: "..........{w}Um... this is kind of out of nowhere, but... want me to teach you how to play an instrument?"{w}{p}"I mean... I did make a promise and all...{w}Er, never mind, that's just my own business.{w}What do you say...?"{w}
note: kocchi no hanashi = "that's my own business". The promise is to Euratia (3974).

en: Learn to play an instrument?
note: Choice prompt, 28 chars.

en: "Really!?{w}Then come over here! Quick, quick!!"{w}
Urna began teaching {0A:0003:000F} how to play an instrument.{w}
"This one goes...... and see, that one's......{w}...Wanna try blowing into it? ...Ahaha, yeah, like that!{w}And then there's......, and......"{w}
note: The dots are the source's deliberately inaudible gaps; kept as gaps. fuite miru = try blowing (a wind instrument).

en: {0A:0003:000F} learned Instrument Playing!{w}
note: Skill name (JOBABL.CSV row 2:24, not yet translated, field max 8). Provisional "Instrument Playing"; align with the ability table once it is named.

en: "With this...{w}I guess I kept my promise...{w}Right, Euratia?"{w}{p}"...All righty!{w}{0A:0003:000F}!!{w}Go out there and give it your all!!!"{w}
"Oh, no?{w}Well, whatever. Come back if you ever feel like it."{w}
note: Response to declining the lesson.

en:
There is an inscription here.{w}{p}Mysterious numbers have been carved into its surface.{w}{p}{0E}        *  714729.301  *        

                      >{0F}{w}
note: Number display: full-width digits/marks converted to ASCII, each full-width space -> 2 spaces; the second line keeps 22 columns before ">". In-game check: alignment.

en: "*Staaare*..."{w}
note: ji~ = staring sound; lengthens in 4069/4073.

en: Urna and Raizam are staring at the inscription.{w}
"*Staaaare*..."{w}
"...Mogugu."{w}
"*Staaaaare*..."{w}
"...Mogugugu."{w}
Supposedly, driving out the Kin of Darkness would get the start time carved into the inscription, but...{w}
"What the heck. It's not working at all."{w}
"That's weird, mogu. I definitely heard it would, mogu..."{w}
As the two of them were talking...{w}

note: Same display as 4062.
Number typed in before the ">": 12 spaces + 8 digits + 2 spaces keeps ">" in the same column as 4082. In-game check: alignment.

en: "Princess, look, mogu!{w}The start time's been carved in, mogu!{w}You've been officially recognized as a New Land, mogu!!"{w}
"Bet they carved the end time in there too, while they were at it."{w}
note: Urna's tease (...tari shite): a mock suggestion, not a claim.

en: "MOGEH!?"{w}
note: Spelling as slice_034.

en: Raizam panicked, but no end time had been carved!{w}
"It's not carved, mogu.{w}Don't scare me like that, moguuu~"{w}
"Well, it's just the kind of thing those guys would do.{w}And I don't even know what this Naru-whoever is like, either."{w}
note: aitsura = the gods. Naru: no pronoun (gender unknown).

en: "...Princess?{w}Aren't you happy you got recognized as a New Land, mogu?"{w}
"Mmm.{w}Happy, not happy... I mean, what do you want me to say?"{w}
"Mogu?"{w}
"Hi-yah!"{w}
Urna kicked the inscription!!{w}
"MOGUUUU!?{w}Princess, what are you doing, moguuuu!?"{w}
"Hmph, this stupid thing!"{w}
note: nani yo, konna mono: contempt for the monument and its approval.

en: "You mustn't kick it, mogu! You'll get in trouble, mogu!"{w}
"Listen up, Raizam!{w}I am me!{w}I don't need anyone's permission to exist!"{w}
"Y-yeah... that's true, mogu, but..."{w}
"Hmph!{w}
note: Build-up fragment (4117-4127, continues into slice_067); quote closes in 4127. Each {0E} part must redraw the previous row exactly.

en: {0E}"Hmph! {0F}Stupid thing!{w}
note: Build-up fragment; see 4117.

en: {0E}"Hmph! Stupid thing! {0F}Stupid thing!{w}
note: Build-up fragment; see 4117.

en:
{0E}"Hmph! Stupid thing! Stupid thing!
{0F}Back then!{w}
note: Build-up fragment; \n kept before {0F} as in source. slice_067 4125/4127 must start with {0E}"Hmph! Stupid thing! Stupid thing!\nBack then! ...
